plugins.name: apollo-legal

plugins.name: apollo-people

plugins.name: apollo-marketing
plugins.description: Apollo's internal brand copilot. Activates only when the user explicitly signals brand intent — asking for on-brand content, checking against Apollo's brand voice or visual guidelines, or requesting brand specs (colors, fonts, logo). Does not activate on generic writing requests. Trigger phrases: "on-brand", "with Apollo's brand", "brand voice", "is this on-brand", "Apollo brand colors/fonts/logo", "make this on-brand", "draft an ad", "write a landing page", "write a brand-compliant [X]".

plugins.name: apollo-gtm-enablement
plugins.description: Creates facilitator-ready enablement decks for Apollo's GTM teams (Sales, CS, Product). Pulls topics from Notion calendars, validates with Salesforce activity and Gong conversations, and produces Apollo-branded training materials backed by real evidence.

plugins.name: apollo-risk
plugins.description: Privacy and compliance skills for Apollo's Legal Risk team — DSR response drafting, privacy queue triage, and regulatory compliance workflows.

plugins.name: apollo-corpsec
plugins.description: Apollo IT CorpSec skills: device & managed-endpoint policy, external storage rules, a device-rules FAQ, and policy exception requests.

plugins.name: apollo-talent
plugins.description: Talent Acquisition skills for Apollo's TA team — company knowledge for candidate briefings and project planning tools for TA initiatives.

plugins.name: apollo-procurement
plugins.description: Procurement & Finance Operations assistant — answers questions about travel & expense (Navan), procurement intake (Zip), accounts payable, corporate cards (Ramp/Brex), and contracts (IronClad) by grounding every answer in the canonical FAQ.
